functions.name: after
functions.doc: Runs `fn` once, `seconds` of game time later.

functions.name: cancel
functions.doc: Stops a timer, a watch or a hotkey; `true` when there was one.

functions.name: clock
functions.doc: The game's time of day as `"HH:MM:SS"`.

functions.name: command
functions.doc: Does what a line of the game menu does: `refuel`, `wash`, `repair`, `shot`, `save`, `load`, `weather`, `later`, `earlier`, `info`, `timetable`, `reset`, `couple`, `uncouple`; `true` when the game knows it (it runs after the frame).

functions.name: debug
functions.doc: A line of the log's debug level (shown with `RUST_LOG=debug`).

functions.name: distance
functions.doc: Metres from the bus to a map point, or `nil` on foot.

functions.name: emit
functions.doc: Sends an event to this plugin's own handlers at once (handy between the modules of a bigger plugin); an error of a handler is this call's.

functions.name: error
functions.doc: The same as an error line (the plugin goes on).

functions.name: every
functions.doc: Runs `fn` every `seconds` of game time.

functions.name: files.append
functions.doc: Adds to the end of a file of the data folder (a log, a CSV of trips).
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: files.delete
functions.doc: Removes a file or an empty folder of the data folder.

functions.name: files.dir
functions.doc: Where the data folder is on this computer (to tell the player; the plugin reaches it with relative paths only).

functions.name: files.exists
functions.doc: Whether the data folder has this file or folder.

functions.name: files.list
functions.doc: The entries of the data folder (or a folder in it): `{name, dir, size}`.
functions.returns: list of tables, or nil and the reason

functions.name: files.mkdir
functions.doc: Makes a folder (and those above it) in the data folder.

functions.name: files.read
functions.doc: A file of the plugin's data folder (`path` relative to it; `..` and absolute paths are refused).
functions.returns: text, or nil and the reason

functions.name: files.write
functions.doc: Writes a file of the data folder (its folders are made); at most 16 MB at once and 256 MB in all.
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: fmt.clock
functions.doc: Seconds since midnight as `"HH:MM"` (`"HH:MM:SS"` with `true`); past midnight wraps.

functions.name: fmt.delay
functions.doc: A delay as a timetable display shows it: `"+2:30"` late, `"-0:45"` early, `"0:00"`.

functions.name: fmt.distance
functions.doc: A distance as `"350 m"` or `"2.4 km"`.

functions.name: fmt.duration
functions.doc: A length of time as people read it: `"45 s"`, `"3 min 05 s"`, `"1 h 20 min"` (negative with a minus).

functions.name: fmt.money
functions.doc: An amount with two decimals and a currency symbol after it (`"12.50 €"`; the game knows no currency of its own).

functions.name: fmt.number
functions.doc: A number with `decimals` (0) and a thousands `separator` (`","`, `" "`; none by default).

functions.name: fmt.pad
functions.doc: A text made `width` characters long with spaces (on the left with `right` = true, to line numbers up), or cut to it.

functions.name: fmt.speed
functions.doc: A speed as `"42 km/h"`, or in `"mph"` or `"m/s"`.

functions.name: fmt.split
functions.doc: A text cut at every `separator` (`","` by default; plainly, no patterns).

functions.name: fmt.trim
functions.doc: A text without the spaces at its ends.

functions.name: has_vehicle
functions.doc: `true` while the player drives a vehicle.

functions.name: info
functions.doc: What the game is doing: `map`, `clock` (seconds since midnight), `day`, `year`, `view`, `paused`, `on_foot`, `multiplayer`, `traffic`, `speed`, `delay`, `map_path`, `version`; with a bus also `tile_x`, `tile_y`, `tile_pos_x`, `tile_pos_y`, `heading`, `vehicle_manufacturer`, `vehicle_model`, `destination`, `passengers`; `crashes`, `heavy_crashes`, `pedestrians_hit`; `situation`; on a duty also `line`, `tour`, `trip`, `trips`, `trip_name`, `terminus`, `stops`, `trip_done`, `next_stop`, `next_stop_number`, `next_stop_arrival`, `next_stop_departure`, `next_stop_id`, `at_stop`, `previous_stop`, `previous_stop_id`, `next_stop_distance`, `previous_stop_distance` (see the plugin docs for each).

functions.name: info_value
functions.doc: One value of `info()` without building the whole table: cheaper for a plugin that reads one or two every frame.

functions.name: json.decode
functions.doc: Reads JSON text: objects and arrays become tables, `null` nil.
functions.returns: value, or nil and the reason

functions.name: json.encode
functions.doc: A value as JSON text (a list as an array, a table with keys as an object; `pretty`: indented).

functions.name: log
functions.doc: A line in `game.log`, tagged `[lua <name>]` (`print` does the same).

functions.name: message
functions.doc: A line of text on the screen (5 seconds when not given).

functions.name: off
functions.doc: Removes a handler added with `on`.

functions.name: on
functions.doc: Adds a handler of an event (see the events); several may hear one event, in the order they were added.

functions.name: other_var
functions.doc: A script variable of one of `others`, or `nil`.

functions.name: others
functions.doc: The other vehicles within `radius` m of the bus (default 300): each `{id, kind, name, x, y, z, heading}`, `kind` being `"ai"` (the traffic) or `"player"` (another player's bus in a LAN game); empty on foot.

functions.name: plugin.broadcast
functions.doc: Sends a message to every other plugin loaded.

functions.name: plugin.disable
functions.doc: Switches the plugin off until its file changes or the game starts again (its `stop` comes).

functions.name: plugin.errors
functions.doc: How many errors the plugin had (at 10 it is switched off).

functions.name: plugin.files
functions.doc: The files of the plugin's own folder (or a folder in it): `{name, dir, size}`.

functions.name: plugin.list
functions.doc: The names of the plugins loaded, this one too.

functions.name: plugin.name
functions.doc: The plugin's name: its file's, or its folder's for a `main.lua`.

functions.name: plugin.permissions
functions.doc: The permissions the plugin has (a plain `.lua` file has them all).

functions.name: plugin.read
functions.doc: A file of the plugin's own folder (a table of stops, a translation): read only, relative to the folder.
functions.returns: text, or nil and the reason

functions.name: plugin.send
functions.doc: Sends a message to another plugin (by its name): it hears `message(from, topic, data)` in its next frame. The data is numbers, texts, booleans or tables of them.

functions.name: plugin.set_setting
functions.doc: Changes a setting (held to its range; saved); `true` when it took the value.

functions.name: plugin.setting
functions.doc: A setting's value (`nil`: no such setting).

functions.name: plugin.settings
functions.doc: Declares the plugin's settings: a list of `{key, type, label, default}` with `type` `"bool"`, `"number"` (`min`, `max`, `step`), `"text"` or `"choice"` (`choices`, a list of texts). The values the player chose before come back (as a table key -> value); the game makes a settings panel of them (`plugin.show_settings`), saves them in the data folder and sends `setting(key, value)` when one changes.

functions.name: plugin.show_settings
functions.doc: Shows the plugin's settings panel (or hides it with `false`); it can be dragged and closed while the panels have the mouse (`ui.focus`). `false` when the plugin declared no settings.

functions.name: position
functions.doc: Where the bus is: map metres (x east, y north, z up) and its heading in degrees clockwise from north; nothing on foot.

functions.name: press
functions.doc: Holds a key of the bus down: fires the trigger `name` (let it go with `release`).

functions.name: release
functions.doc: Lets a key go: fires `<name>_off`.

functions.name: send
functions.doc: Sends `data` as one UDP datagram to `127.0.0.1:port`: to another program on this computer, never over the network. Not sent when the port is below 1024 or one of the game's multiplayer ports (27015-27024), the message is longer than 8 KB, or the plugin sent 100 in the last second.
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: set_other_var
functions.doc: Sets a script variable of one of `others`; `true` when that vehicle has it. An AI vehicle keeps it until its scripts write it again; another player's bus takes its values from the network again.

functions.name: set_str
functions.doc: Sets a string variable; `true` when the bus has it.

functions.name: set_var
functions.doc: Sets a script variable; `true` when the bus has that variable.

functions.name: speed
functions.doc: The bus's speed in km/h, forwards or backwards (0 on foot).

functions.name: storage.all
functions.doc: Everything stored, as one table.

functions.name: storage.clear
functions.doc: Removes every key.

functions.name: storage.delete
functions.doc: Removes a key; `true` when it was there.

functions.name: storage.get
functions.doc: A value the plugin stored, or `nil`. The storage is the plugin's own and survives the session (kept as `storage.json` in its data folder).

functions.name: storage.keys
functions.doc: The keys stored, in the order they were first set.

functions.name: storage.save
functions.doc: Writes the storage now (it is written by itself when the game ends).

functions.name: storage.set
functions.doc: Stores a value under a key: a number, text, boolean or a table of them (`nil` removes it). It is written when the game ends, the plugin is loaded again, or `storage.save()` is called.

functions.name: str
functions.doc: A string variable of the bus's scripts (`IBIS_terminus_name`).

functions.name: sys
functions.doc: A system variable of the scripts: `Time`, `Day`, `Weather_Temperature`, `SunAlt`, ... (read only).

functions.name: time
functions.doc: Seconds of game time since the plugin started (stands still while paused).

functions.name: trigger
functions.doc: A key press of the bus: fires the trigger, then `<name>_off`.

functions.name: ui.clear
functions.doc: Removes every panel of the plugin.

functions.name: ui.focus
functions.doc: `true`: the panels get the mouse (the cursor shows, a click goes to the panel under it and none to the bus); `false`, Esc or a menu of the game gives it back. Returns the new state.

functions.name: ui.focused
functions.doc: Whether the panels have the mouse.

functions.name: ui.remove
functions.doc: Removes a panel; `true` when there was one.

functions.name: ui.screen
functions.doc: The screen in the panels' pixels, and how many of the screen's own pixels one of them is.

functions.name: ui.set
functions.doc: Creates the panel `id` or replaces it; a table that is not right gives `false` and where (`"children[2].size: a number is expected"`). The same table again changes nothing.
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: ui.toast
functions.doc: A notification card at the top right, newest at the top; it goes after `opts.seconds` (1 to 60, default 5). `opts`: `title`, `icon`, `color`. A plugin shows 8 at most: a ninth makes its oldest go.
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: util.date
functions.doc: A real time (`util.now()` by default) as `{year, month, day, hour, minute, second, weekday}` in UTC (`weekday` 1 Monday).

functions.name: util.ms
functions.doc: Milliseconds of real time since the game started: for timing a plugin's own work.

functions.name: util.now
functions.doc: The real time: seconds since 1970 (UTC), with fractions.

functions.name: util.random
functions.doc: A random number: 0 to 1 without arguments, else a whole number from `min` to `max` (as `math.random`, but not repeating the same row in every plugin).

functions.name: var
functions.doc: A script variable of the bus (`Velocity`, `elec_busbar_main`, the names the `.osc` files and `.opl` lists use); `nil` without a bus or for a name it does not have.

functions.name: vars
functions.doc: The names of every variable of the bus's scripts, or of every string variable with `"str"`.

functions.name: vec.angle_diff
functions.doc: The turn from heading `a` to heading `b`, -180 to 180 degrees (right positive).

functions.name: vec.bearing
functions.doc: The heading from one map point to another.

functions.name: vec.clamp
functions.doc: `x` held between `min` and `max`.

functions.name: vec.distance
functions.doc: Metres between two map points (on the ground: x and y).

functions.name: vec.distance3
functions.doc: Metres between two points in space.

functions.name: vec.dot
functions.doc: The dot product of two 2D vectors.

functions.name: vec.heading
functions.doc: The heading of a direction on the map, degrees clockwise from north (0 to 360), as the game's headings.

functions.name: vec.length
functions.doc: The length of a vector (2D, or 3D with `z`).

functions.name: vec.lerp
functions.doc: From `a` to `b` by `t` (0 to 1, not held to it).

functions.name: vec.normalize
functions.doc: The vector made 1 long (0 stays 0).

functions.name: vec.rotate
functions.doc: A vector turned clockwise by `degrees` (as headings turn).

functions.name: vec.to_local
functions.doc: A map point seen from a place facing `heading`: metres to the right and ahead of it.

functions.name: vehicle
functions.doc: The vehicle's name (manufacturer and type), or `nil` on foot.

functions.name: vehicle_manufacturer
functions.doc: The manufacturer part of the vehicle's name, as its `[friendlyname]` has it (`"Solaris III Gen"`).

functions.name: vehicle_model
functions.doc: The model part of the vehicle's name (`"Urbino 10 / 2D"`).

functions.name: warn
functions.doc: The same as a warning.

functions.name: watch
functions.doc: Runs `fn(new, old)` whenever a value changes: `watch(name, fn)` a variable of the bus, `watch(kind, name, fn)` of kind `"var"`, `"str"`, `"sys"` or `"info"` (a key of `info()`).

events.name: start
events.doc: Right after the plugin was loaded (also after a reload).

events.name: vehicle
events.doc: The player got into a vehicle, changed it, or left it (`nil`).

events.name: frame
events.doc: Every frame of the game, after the bus's own scripts; not while paused. `dt` is the frame's seconds of game time.

events.name: stop
events.doc: The game ends, or the plugin is about to be loaded again.

events.name: key
events.doc: A key went down (`true`) or came up: winit's name of it (`"KeyH"`, `"F5"`, `"Numpad8"`).

events.name: next_stop
events.doc: The duty's next stop changed, also to one of the same name (`omsi.info().next_stop_number` tells them apart).

events.name: view
events.doc: The view changed (`"driver"`, `"pax"`, `"outside"`, `"free"`, `"foot"`).

events.name: duty
events.doc: A line and tour were taken (or given up: `nil`).

events.name: crash
events.doc: The player's bus crashed: every crash, also one the same as the last (the screen's "Crash: 136 kJ"); above 50 kJ it is a heavy one.

events.name: pedestrian
events.doc: The bus knocked people down.

events.name: stops_skipped
events.doc: The duty jumped ahead: the bus passed stops of its trip without stopping (or was moved) and is now at a later one; the stops are numbered in the trip from 1.

events.name: service
events.doc: The player's bus was serviced or moved. `kind`: `"refuel"` (amount: litres put in), `"wash"` (amount: the dirt left), `"repair"` (amount: the game minutes it took), `"reset"` or `"teleport"`; `by`: `"player"`, `"plugin"`, `"host"` or `"game"`.

events.name: trip_done
events.doc: A trip of the duty ended, once: its number in the duty, `"arrived"`, `"skipped"` or `"given_up"`, then its ratings in per cent (driving, comfort, ticket selling).

events.name: jolt
events.doc: The bus braked, sped up or cornered hard enough to cost driving rating (m/s², signed); at most one a second.

events.name: ticket_sold
events.doc: A ticket was sold at the cash desk: its name and price as the bus's ticket list has them.

events.name: ui_click
events.doc: A button (or another clickable part) of one of the plugin's panels was clicked; `element` is `nil` for the panel itself. Enter in a text field is a click on it.

events.name: ui_focus
events.doc: The panels got the mouse or gave it back (also by Esc, or a menu of the game opening).

events.name: ui_change
events.doc: A checkbox (`true`/`false`), slider (its number), text field (its text, at every key) or tabs element (the tab's number from 1) of the plugin's panels was changed by the player.

events.name: message
events.doc: Another plugin sent this one a message (`plugin.send`, `plugin.broadcast`): its name, the topic and the data (numbers, texts, tables).

events.name: setting
events.doc: The player changed one of the plugin's settings in its settings panel (`plugin.settings`).

events.name: door
events.doc: A door leaf of the player's bus opened (`true`) or closed: its number from 1, front to back.

events.name: doors
events.doc: The bus's doors opened (`true`: one or more open) or were all closed.

events.name: engine_start
events.doc: The player's bus's engine started running.

events.name: engine_stop
events.doc: Its engine stopped.

events.name: gear
events.doc: The gear engaged changed (-1 reverse, 0 neutral), where the bus has a gearbox it shows.

events.name: indicator
events.doc: The indicators changed: `"off"`, `"left"`, `"right"` or `"hazard"`.

events.name: headlights
events.doc: The headlights changed: 0 off, 1 side lights, 2 dipped, 3 high beam.

events.name: horn
events.doc: The horn started (`true`) or stopped.

events.name: handbrake
events.doc: The parking brake was put on (`true`) or released.

events.name: stop_request
events.doc: A passenger asked to stop (`true`), or the request went out.

events.name: passengers
events.doc: The number of passengers aboard the player's bus changed.

events.name: passenger_board
events.doc: People got into the player's bus: how many, and the stop they waited at (its map object id, `nil` when none).

events.name: passenger_alight
events.doc: People got out of the player's bus.

events.name: stop_arrive
events.doc: The bus came to the duty's next stop (within 25 m of it): its name, map object id, number in the trip (from 1) and the delay in seconds (late positive).

events.name: stop_depart
events.doc: The bus left the stop it stood at (more than 35 m from it, or the duty moved on): the same values, the delay as it left.

events.name: trip_start
events.doc: The duty moved on to another trip: its number in the duty (from 1), the timetable's name of the trip and its terminus.

events.name: duty_start
events.doc: A duty was taken.

events.name: duty_end
events.doc: The duty was given up (or another taken: `duty_end` of the old one comes first).

events.name: destination
events.doc: The destination the bus shows changed.

events.name: coupled
events.doc: Something was coupled to or uncoupled from the bus: the parts behind it now.

events.name: minute
events.doc: The game's clock reached a new minute (also when it was set).

events.name: hour
events.doc: The game's clock reached a new hour.

events.name: day
events.doc: The game's date changed.

events.name: tile
events.doc: The player's bus drove onto another tile of the map (numbered as global.cfg's `[map]` list).

events.name: weather
events.doc: The weather changed: another weather file, rain or snow beginning or ending, the snow cover, the clouds.

events.name: light_ahead
events.doc: The traffic light ahead of the bus (within 80 m) changed or a new one came: its aspect (`"red"`, `"red_yellow"`, `"green"`, `"green_yellow"`, `"yellow"`, `"dark"`, `nil` when none is ahead any more) and its distance in metres.

events.name: red_light
events.doc: The bus drove past a traffic light showing red (or red and yellow) at more than 5 km/h.

events.name: speed_limit
events.doc: The speed limit of the lane the bus drives on changed.

events.name: ai_collision
events.doc: The player's bus hit an AI vehicle (its id, as `traffic.list` gives it) with this energy.

events.name: pause
events.doc: The game was paused (the plugins stand still until `resume`; nothing else comes in between).

events.name: resume
events.doc: The game goes on after a pause.

events.name: menu_open
events.doc: The game menu opened.

events.name: menu_close
events.doc: The game menu closed.

events.name: screenshot
events.doc: A screenshot was taken: its file.

events.name: controller_button
events.doc: A button of a steering wheel, joystick or gamepad went down (`true`) or up: the device's name and the button's number.

events.name: lan_join
events.doc: A player joined the LAN session (or came back).

events.name: lan_leave
events.doc: A player left the LAN session.

events.name: lan_message
events.doc: The same plugin on another player's game sent this one a message (`lan.send`): the player's id and the text.

events.name: lan_chat
events.doc: A line was said in the LAN session's chat (by another player or this one).
